# POWER SHIFT

> Software studio in Cairo building high-performance websites, e-commerce platforms, SaaS products, and custom operations systems for companies in Egypt and the GCC.

POWER SHIFT designs, builds, and supports bilingual Arabic/English products. Work is scoped in a 20-minute call, then delivered with a named owner through launch and maintenance.

## Site

- [Home](https://www.powershift.space/): Studio overview, selected work, services, process, and FAQ
- [Home (Arabic)](https://www.powershift.space/ar): Arabic-language version of the studio site
- [About](https://www.powershift.space/about): Official company profile and founder information
- [About (Arabic)](https://www.powershift.space/ar/about): Arabic official company profile
- [Work](https://www.powershift.space/work): Live product case studies
- [Services](https://www.powershift.space/services): Websites, e-commerce, SaaS, and operations systems
- [Contact](https://www.powershift.space/contact): Book a 20-minute scope call
- [Blog](https://www.powershift.space/blog): Practical notes on websites, search, leads, shops, and software
- [Blog (Arabic)](https://www.powershift.space/ar/blog): Arabic-language notes for the same topics

## Selected work

- [VIA Holidays](https://www.powershift.space/work/via-holidays.html): Travel website for Egypt, Jordan, and Türkiye
- [Nourvive](https://www.powershift.space/work/nourvive.html): Bilingual beauty e-commerce
- [Corolla](https://www.powershift.space/work/corolla.html): Food e-commerce
- [URUZ](https://www.powershift.space/work/uruz.html): Luxury beauty commerce
- [Lodiamo](https://www.powershift.space/work/lodiamo.html): UAE food trade website
- [Availio](https://www.powershift.space/work/availio.html): Property operations software
- [7aseb](https://www.powershift.space/work/haseb.html): Operations and finance system
